title: Savory Mediterranean Greek Yogurt Bowls
intro: Starting your morning with a generous serving of lean protein and fiber helps maintain steady energy right through to lunch. This fresh, zero-cook bowl relies on artichokes and whole-wheat pita to deliver lasting fullness without weighing you down.

ingredients.name: Cherry tomatoes
ingredients.canonical_name: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

ingredients.name: Low-sodium canned artichoke hearts
ingredients.canonical_name: Artichokes, canned, water pack, no salt added

ingredients.name: Shelled pumpkin seeds (pepitas)
ingredients.canonical_name: Seeds, pumpkin and squash seeds, whole, roasted, without salt

instructions: Whisk the Greek yogurt and lemon juice together in a small bowl until completely smooth.
Spread the yogurt mixture evenly across the bottoms of two wide, shallow bowls.
Arrange the chopped cucumber, halved cherry tomatoes, and quartered artichoke hearts generously over the yogurt.
Drizzle the extra-virgin olive oil over the vegetables, then scatter the minced olives, pumpkin seeds, and dried oregano on top.
Toast the whole-wheat pitas in a toaster until slightly crisp and warm, then cut them into wedges.
Serve the bowls immediately with the warm pita wedges on the side for scooping.
variation: Swap the whole-wheat pita for a side of cooked quinoa.
conservation: Keeps 2 days refrigerated; toast the pita just before serving.
